parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the dishwasher, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and encloses the internal mechanisms, racks, and door of the dishwasher, ensuring stability and durability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is a fixed, non-moving part that provides rigidity and protection for the internal components.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the front door of the dishwasher, made of stainless steel, designed to seal the washing compartment during operation.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior for loading and unloading dishes and seals tightly to prevent water leakage during washing cycles.
parts.Movement_description: The door is hinged at the bottom and can rotate outward and downward to open, and upward to close.
